sentences.text: CORAM:
HON'BLE
MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER

This Court on 03.06.2025 had observed as follows:
"This Court, on 17.04.2025, had passed the following order:
"Matter is called out.
There is no representation for the petitioners or the proposed respondent.
Re - list this matter after Summer Vacation, 2025."
Even today, there is no representation on behalf of the petitioners nor the proposed respondents.
As a last chance, list the matter on 05.06.2025.
In the event there would be no representation as is observed hereinabove, the petition would be dismissed for non-prosecution."

2. Noticing the fact that the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners has been continuously absent, the matter was posted today and was indicated in the event that there would be no representation on behalf of the petitioners, the matter would be dismissed.
NC: 2025:KHC:19121 HC-KAR 3.
There is no representation on behalf of the petitioners even today as has been throughout.
Therefore, the writ petition is dismissed for its non-prosecution.

Sd/-
(M.NAGAPRASANNA) JUDGE JY CT:
